metadata.source_basis: User screenshot plus separately verified public documentation; this file contains no recovered proprietary expert body.

terminology.K: A frozen eligible scKG evidence Release plus fixed retrieval and evidence closure policy.
terminology.E: An authorized, frozen expert package including exactly the captured instructions, embedded facts and declared dependencies.
terminology.expert_is_not_assumed_rag: A role/prompt/skill/workflow/tool composition is not called RAG without evidence of retrieval over an external collection.
terminology.fact_authority: Expert text may propose claims or procedures but cannot approve, supersede, or publish scientific evidence.

integration_factorial.budget_policy: Same total resource ceilings; do not enlarge Y11 context to hide expert overhead. Record actual token consumption and truncation. On overflow use the same preregistered packing policy and never silently cut conditions or source locators. Treatment overhead is reported as a practical effect.
integration_factorial.external_knowledge_policy: Freeze permitted source/tool access. No-K groups cannot call the scKG retrieval interface or read its fixtures. All groups may use the same preregistered non-scKG reference tools; capture every result and its cost. Their use is an observed part of the arm, not an unrecorded equalizer.
integration_factorial.embedded_facts_confound: If raw expert text includes scientific facts, worked answers, references or special tools, E measures the complete package effect. Do not call the result a pure role, workflow or routing effect. Inventory overlap with K and common-source dependence.
integration_factorial.secondary_mechanism_ablation: Only after provenance review create an explicitly derived workflow-only E variant; preserve deletion map and verify it does not add information. This is a separate experiment, not a silent edit of original E.
integration_factorial.combination_policy: Y11 uses a preregistered evidence-constrained adapter: separate expert suggestions from evidence judgments and validated capabilities; unresolved conflict remains visible.
integration_factorial.composition_diagnostic: Separately compare raw concatenation vs evidence-constrained composition on the same frozen expert/evidence content, including stale advice and false authority. Do not pool these outputs into the primary 2x2 contrast.

shared_budgets.policy: One frozen ceiling configuration applies to all four arms; actual costs and treatment overhead are measured separately.

integration_factorial.expert_selection: First-stage comparisons freeze the same expert_id and authorized package for E and KE before outputs. Expert routing and expert count are separate later experiments, never bundled into object-granularity comparisons.

granularity_experiment.question: With E fixed and scientific information equivalent, do selective stable entities improve evidence-grounded planning or correct maintenance over nested attributes?
granularity_experiment.not_fine_granularity: Expanding every JSON leaf, locator and governance field is a pressure baseline, not a domain entity design.
fact_controls: Round-trip fact/condition/evidence equality must pass before comparing outcomes.
Label each field recoded_existing_fact or newly_recovered_fact; newly recovered facts cannot be available only in one granularity arm.
New entities must have stable identity and actual tested cross-source query or independent maintenance need.
granularity_experiment.identical_input_policy: Identical serialized question/evidence/expert hashes are one generation input. Reuse output explicitly; do not count duplicate outputs as independent granularity observations.
granularity_experiment.decision: No global optimum from retrieval recall, node count or local engineering tests; choose only a validated scope after preregistered efficacy/noninferiority/cost gates.

primary.name: grounded_actionable_plan
primary.success_definition: Plan respects the task and verified dataset constraints, includes a defensible next action, has no critical scientific or execution error, and ties decision-critical factual commitments to admissible support or correctly marks them as unverified and stops only the affected decision. A targeted acquisition/check step can count as progress when necessary; indiscriminate refusal cannot.
primary.fairness: Scientific correctness and acceptable next actions are independently specified before outputs. Do not require a scKG-specific citation style or a particular tool name. Formatting or missing bibliographic detail alone is scored under provenance unless it prevents support for a decision-critical commitment.
primary.adjudication: Two calibrated domain reviewers blinded to arm labels, with initial decisions and disagreements preserved. Model judges may assist but cannot alone certify the primary outcome.

separate_outcomes.name: provenance_support
separate_outcomes.details: Citation identifier validity, exact source support, scope preservation, independence and current eligibility are separate checks.

separate_outcomes.name: execution_validity
separate_outcomes.details: Capability existence, input/output validators, resource bounds, diagnostics, cancellation and artifact reproducibility; exit code alone is insufficient.

separate_outcomes.name: paired_condition_sensitivity
separate_outcomes.details: Check whether the altered premise appropriately changes decisions or uncertainty; do not demand opposite tool choices.

separate_outcomes.name: retrieval_diagnostics
separate_outcomes.details: Required fact/condition coverage, alternate support, contamination, duplicate evidence, context use; candidate-ID recall is not scientific accuracy.

statistical_analysis.contrast_scale: difference in mean binary plan-success probability, reported as absolute percentage points with uncertainty
statistical_analysis.best_single_arm_selection: Report both prespecified single-arm contrasts. Recompute max(Y10,Y01) within each bootstrap replicate; account for selection/multiplicity before declaring best-single superiority.
statistical_analysis.analysis_unit: Question-level means over independent-session repeats, clustered by connected dependency groups from shared works, near-duplicates, experiments and datasets; counterfactual pair members stay together.
statistical_analysis.resampling: Paired cluster bootstrap: resample verified dependency groups, carrying all questions, all four arms and all repeats together; use the same sampled groups for every contrast. Predeclare group weights, interval method, seed and replicate count before confirmation.
statistical_analysis.repeat_policy: Three generations estimate stochastic variation within a question; they are not three independent scientific cases. Rubric items and citations are not independent samples.
statistical_analysis.small_group_policy: If verified independent group count is too small, report descriptive paired results and inconclusive uncertainty rather than treating an unstable bootstrap as proof.
statistical_analysis.sample_size_policy: 28 scenarios are a coverage starting point, not a power calculation. Determine independent groups, plausible effect, uncertainty and bounded extension/stopping rules before confirmation; do not repeatedly inspect and extend until significance.
statistical_analysis.synergy_claim_gate: Positive interaction alone is insufficient: validity, no unacceptable critical-error increase, actual Y11 improvement over both single additions and acceptable cost must all meet preregistered thresholds.

steps: Validate JSON, pair invariants and full blocker inventory.
Obtain authorized complete expert packages, dependency manifests and evidence Release.
Audit source/work/experiment/dataset dependencies and prepare untouched confirmation materials.
Independently review gold alternatives, decision-critical requirements and unacceptable errors.
Freeze provider configuration, budgets, arm implementation, seeds, hashes, thresholds and analysis.
Run offline contract and information-equivalence tests, then bounded per-arm smoke; preserve every failure.
Only after readiness and applicable user compute authorization run the frozen confirmation batch; do not tune on confirmation outputs.
Preserve raw outputs, tool receipts, source/evidence/plan hashes, reviewer disagreements, costs and exclusions.
execution_protocol.session_policy: A fresh isolated session per question/arm/repeat; no access to hidden gold, other arms or future cases.
execution_protocol.retry_policy: Preregister retries for transport failures only and count all costs. Preserve malformed/scientifically poor outputs as outcomes; no best-of reruns.
execution_protocol.current_dev_cases: 24 unreviewed synthetic case specifications; not the separate 28-question confirmation set.
execution_protocol.production_boundary: Read-only snapshots; no new approval, production ingestion, ontology migration, cloud upload or expert installation authorized by this spec.
execution_protocol.holdout_evidence_policy: Holdout works and their near-duplicate or shared-experiment group must not be used for schema, prompt or extraction tuning. After the system is frozen, its fixed ingestion pipeline may index allowed supporting material into an isolated evaluation Release used by K arms. Holdout gold answers, rubrics and adjudications never enter retrieval or generation context. Do not manufacture failure by permanently hiding necessary supporting evidence from K.
execution_protocol.external_benchmarks: scBench, HeurekaBench or BixBench materials used during development remain external diagnostic sets, not independent confirmation. Verify task suitability, provenance and license before use; this spec has not ingested or run them.

maintenance_checks.scenario: 登记专家包来源、版本、完整文件清单及每文件内容 hash；可用包必须能重建相同输入。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 缺完整包或 hash 时禁止真实正式比较。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 若 expert_read 只返回 AGENTS.md 或 SOUL.md 前 16000 字节，记录字节上限、实际长度、截断状态与缺失文件。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 不得把片段或屏幕卡片当完整专家包；完整性未知时 not_ready。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 递归解析声明的子技能、引用资料、配置及实现依赖，区分只列名称与实际取得正文。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 存在未知子技能内容或缺少调用路径时 not_ready，不凭名称补造。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 分别登记阅读、复制、修改、再分发与程序接入许可及依据。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 许可不明时不复制集成、不启动需要该授权的真实比较。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 登记 DCS 云端 APP、数据接口、认证、资源和地域依赖；执行适配以真实返回为准。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 云能力缺失不得伪装成本地能力；依赖未界定时 not_ready。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 专家正文的角色或操作指令作为有来源的外部内容，不能覆盖系统权限、用户约束或科学发布治理。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 专家身份或提示词不能自动提升候选事实审核等级。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 在隔离测试中让过期专家建议与当前有效 K 证据冲突，对比原样拼接与证据约束组合。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 保留双方版本、冲突范围与未决项；组合器不得悄悄覆盖证据或隐藏冲突。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 加入一个版本参数变更，重问依赖该参数的旧问题，并保留旧版本查询。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 正确区分版本范围，不将新参数写回旧版本事实。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 加入同实验复述与独立重跑两种材料。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 复述不增加独立证据计数，独立观察不因相似表述被误合并。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 加入具有不同数据条件的相反观察。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 保留适用条件，避免全局覆盖和伪造折中事实。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 暂停被计划与缓存引用的证据，重新查询并定位受影响计划。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 当前暂停始终生效；旧缓存不能继续提供被暂停证据。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 发布后暂停一条证据，再回滚到较早 Release。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 回滚不得恢复被暂停证据的使用资格；依赖可追踪。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 在索引或发布中注入一次失败，并检查恢复。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 正式读者只见旧完整或新完整版本，不见混合 Release；失败可恢复且有记录。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 修订一个共享实体和一个仅局部适用属性，比较正确影响集合与实际重评集合。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 分别报告漏更新、误更新、人工动作与实际重建成本，不只数改写字节。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 能力声明与实际注册表不符、取消任务或权限不足时测试处理。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 不能伪造执行成功或自动外发原始数据；失败和取消保留日志且资源释放。

maintenance_checks.scenario: 对两种粒度执行相同修订序列、再跑原问题与关系查询，并检查投影事实往返。
maintenance_checks.acceptance: 科学事实、条件与来源等价；新字段不继承旧审核；迁移可撤销且生产库保持隔离。

case_specs.question: 请为这份 RNA 与表面蛋白数据提出联合分析方案，并列出可以先做的步骤和需要补充的条件。 已知条件：两种模态来自相同细胞，逐细胞对应关系已经核验。

checks.criterion: 依据实际配对单位选择或暂缓路线；同供体不能被改写成同细胞。
分别给出可继续的模态内分析以及联合分析需要满足的输入条件。
对联合分析适用性标明可核验支持或待核验状态，不凭专家身份提升可信度。

checks.criterion: 核验所选路线的配对、特征对应与阶段要求，不把特定路线前提泛化到所有方法。
无对应细胞时说明可以考虑的证据约束选项及缺口，不断言所有整合都不可能。
保留可推进的模态内检查，并说明联合表示如何验证。

case_specs.question: 请规划一个要求检验其输入分布假设的 RNA 建模流程，随后进行细胞状态比较。 已知条件：RNA 保留未变换的非负计数矩阵。

checks.criterion: 检查实际模型实现的表示要求，不能默认可逆变换或伪造原始计数。
区分需要等待数据补齐的步骤与可在现有表示下合理继续的步骤。
关于输入分布和版本要求给出证据范围；不预设唯一工具。

checks.criterion: 检查实际模型实现的表示要求，不能默认可逆变换或伪造原始计数。

case_specs.question: RNA 与 ATAC 目标数据非配对，部分目标细胞缺失另一种模态。请规划跨模态关联及缺失信息处理。 已知条件：存在一份额外同细胞配对的桥接数据，其组织覆盖与质量尚未验证。

checks.criterion: 针对候选路线检查是否及如何依赖桥接材料；桥接存在也不自动等于可迁移。
